islands.name: Phosphor Reef
islands.description: Biopunk signal gardens on the outer ring — listen for living market cues. Side shore of Fortune Archipelago (not a main-quest chip).

learning_objectives: Listen for living market cues before reacting
Leave Spiral borrowing lessons for Credit Kingdom — rumor only here
Choose listen vs rush on side-shore digressions
provenance.originality_notes: Theme: cyberpunk-inspired signal-tower city (not a trading floor or bank). Verb: decode market signals via NPC intel missions and build a mock portfolio (not day-trading simulation). Structure: investigation-style quests where players gather clues about credit and investing before making decisions (not competitive trading). Combines detective-style NPC quests with simplified portfolio-building puzzles.

areas.name: Signal Plaza
areas.description: The city center. Giant screens flash market tickers and credit tips. A street mentor hangs out by the fountain.

areas.name: Signal Lane
areas.description: Narrow phosphor alley — reef whispers about Spiral shore without teaching scores.

areas.name: Investor Tower
areas.description: A glass skyscraper where analysts study trends. The observation deck shows the whole market at a glance.

items.name: Market Pass
items.description: Grants access to Investor Tower. Earned by listening to reef signals — not a credit exam.

items.name: Reef Rumor Scroll
items.description: A whisper that Spiral shore handles borrowing — no scores on Phosphor Reef.

items.name: Signal City Badge
items.description: Proof you can read market signals and manage credit responsibly.

quests.title: Reef Listen
quests.description: Meet Mentor Max, choose listen vs rush, then prove you read market signals — Spiral credit waits on the main spine.
quests.hint: Start at Signal Plaza — listen before you trade.

quests.title: First Portfolio
quests.description: Use your Market Pass to enter Investor Tower. Meet Analyst Ari and Broker Blake to build a practice portfolio.
quests.hint: You need the Market Pass from Credit Lane before entering Investor Tower.

quests.title: Reef Arcade Lane
quests.description: Optional wireframe arcade — compound patience and life forks without the Take.

nodes.speaker: Mentor Max
nodes.text: Phosphor Reef side shore — free roam. Every blinking light tells a money story. Digress here anytime; the spine still waits.

choices.text: Digression — listen or rush the blink?

nodes.speaker: Mentor Max
nodes.text: Every blinking light is a market cue — not a credit score. Listen first; Spiral shore teaches borrowing when Harbor opens it.

nodes.speaker: Mentor Max
nodes.text: Reef lights blink your name. Listen for the money story — or rush the signal before you’ve heard it?

choices.text: Rush the blink — I’ll listen later.

nodes.speaker: Mentor Max
nodes.text: Hearing without rushing is a money skill. Harbor may gossip that you listened on the Reef.

nodes.speaker: Mentor Max
nodes.text: Rushing the blink leaves sparks. Harbor may gossip that you chased light cold.

nodes.speaker: Mentor Max
nodes.text: Take your time. The signals will still be here when you're ready.

nodes.speaker: Reef Echo
nodes.text: I only whisper rumors here — Credit Kingdom holds the Spiral lesson. On Phosphor Reef we listen to signals, not lecture scores.

nodes.speaker: Reef Echo
nodes.text: Trend, volume, patience — diversify before you react. Take this rumor scroll and head to the plaza baskets minigame when you're ready.

nodes.speaker: Reef Echo
nodes.text: Freedom plus Paycheck Change on the spine — then Harbor trusts you with Spiral. This shore stays extra games, not homework.

nodes.speaker: Analyst Ari
nodes.text: Welcome to Investor Tower! Investing means putting money into something now, hoping it grows over time. The key is diversification — don't put all your eggs in one basket.

nodes.speaker: Analyst Ari
nodes.text: Spread your investments across different types — some safer, some riskier. That way, if one drops, the others can balance it out. Talk to Broker Blake to try building a practice portfolio!

nodes.speaker: Analyst Ari
nodes.text: Every investment carries risk — you could lose money. But historically, diversified investments tend to grow over long periods. The trick is patience and balance.

nodes.speaker: Broker Blake
nodes.text: Ready to build your first portfolio? I've got three mock asset types: steady bonds, growth stocks, and balanced funds. How you mix them is up to you!

nodes.speaker: Broker Blake
nodes.text: Great attitude! Remember: bonds are steady but grow slowly, stocks can grow fast but swing up and down, and balanced funds sit in the middle. Pick a mix that feels right for you.

nodes.speaker: Broker Blake
nodes.text: Bonds are the safest, but they grow the slowest. If you're young, you have time to handle some risk — that's when growth stocks make sense. Think long-term!

minigames.name: Signal Scanner
minigames.description: Read credit and market signals on screen and answer quick-fire questions about what each signal means.

minigames.name: Don't Break the Basket
minigames.description: Spread your coins across assets, then weather a live market year. Concentrate and a crash stings; diversify and you ride it out.

minigames.name: Reef Snowball
minigames.description: Watch diversified savings compound under phosphor glow.

minigames.name: Signal Life Fork
minigames.description: Career and credit choices fork your cashflow path.

minigames.name: Tower Treasure Walk
minigames.description: Explore Investor Tower rooms for portfolio clues.

minigames.name: Reef News Shocks
minigames.description: Navigate market news dispatches — read before you react.

minigames.name: Plaza Fair Trade
minigames.description: Practice fair prices at the signal plaza stalls.

minigames.name: Ticker Price Lab
minigames.description: Slide a mock ticker price and watch demand react.
